A REGIONAL DISTRICT'S DOCUMENT REPRODUCED IN THE TOWN REPORT: this is the Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School District's general fund, not Lunenburg's -- the publisher is Monty Tech, and it is the per-function detail behind the `Operation and Maintenance Expenses` block on page 142. THE PRINTED HEADER, VERBATIM, COLUMN BY COLUMN: `Function Code` | `Function Description` | `FY 14 Actual Expenditures` | `FY 15 Actual Expenditures` | `FY16 Actual Expenditures` | `FY17 Actual Expenditures` | `FY18 Proposed Budget` | `Increase/ Decrease FY 17 to FY 18` | `Percentage Incr/Decr FY17 to FY18`. The table prints 40 numbered detail lines, EIGHT highlighted `FUNCTION nnnn` subtotal rows, and one `Total` row. *** THE COLUMNS MIX ACTUALS AND BUDGET AND THE PAGE SAYS SO IN ITS OWN HEADER. *** FY14, FY15, FY16 and FY17 are headed `Actual Expenditures`; FY18 is headed `Proposed Budget`. The `Increase/Decrease` and `Percentage` columns the page prints are therefore computed from an ACTUAL to a BUDGET, which is CLAUDE.md rule 1 exactly -- a growth rate measured that way is partly growth and partly the step between the two stages. Page 142 carries the same boundary and records it in the same words. The figures are transcribed as the page prints them; they may NEVER be differenced across that boundary in a projection. HOW IT WAS READ: the page is a SINGLE EMBEDDED SCAN -- pdfplumber returns one word (the folio) and one image -- so the scanner's own pixels were taken straight off the PDF with pypdf and read in three horizontal bands at native resolution. Only the page's TITLE is printed sideways; the table itself is upright. Neither render script was used, so neither could clip it. THE GRAIN IS ONE FILE PER FUNCTION, because that is the unit the page proves: each `FUNCTION nnnn` row is the printed total of the detail lines above it, and the `Total` row is the printed total of the eight FUNCTION rows. `fy2017-p143-function-totals.csv` is that second grain and holds the eight subtotals against the printed `Total`; the eight per-function files hold the detail. THE TWO ARE NEVER TO BE ADDED TOGETHER. WHAT PROVES IT, three ways. (1) THE EIGHT FUNCTION SUBTOTALS against their own detail lines, six columns each. (2) THE PRINTED `Total` against the eight subtotals: it closes EXACTLY -- to the dollar, not within a tolerance -- in FIVE of its six columns, $24,785,240 / $26,228,813 / $26,364,958 / $26,895,680 and $530,722; the sixth is the attested FY15 case below. (3) THE ROW IDENTITY `FY18 Proposed Budget` less `FY17 Actual Expenditures` equals `Increase/ Decrease`, which closes EXACTLY on all 40 detail lines, all 8 subtotals and the `Total` row -- 49 of 49, no residual anywhere. AND AN INDEPENDENT INSTRUMENT ALREADY HELD HALF OF IT: page 142's `Operation and Maintenance Expenses` block, read and proven separately, prints the SAME eight categories for 14-15, 15-16, 16-17 and 17-18. Every one of those 28 figures agrees with this page to the dollar with TWO exceptions -- the FY15 Fixed Assets case attested below, and `Operations & Maintenance` FY17, which page 142 prints as 3,183,704 and page 143 as 3,183,703. THE DECLARED TOLERANCE IS $1.00 AND IT IS DERIVED, NOT FITTED. The table displays WHOLE DOLLARS over amounts carrying cents, so a printed subtotal is the rounded sum and not the sum of the rounded parts. The widest block here has TEN addends (FUNCTION 2000), so the arithmetic bound is 10 x $0.50 plus the subtotal's own $0.50, i.e. $5.50. THE OBSERVED MAXIMUM ACROSS ALL 48 SUBTOTAL-COLUMN ASSERTIONS IS $1, on seven of them, and the printed `Total` closes at ZERO in five of six columns. *** THE $40 BETWEEN THIS PAGE AND PAGE 142 IS NOT A TYPESETTING ERROR, AND THE ARITHMETIC SETTLES THAT. *** Page 143 prints a FY14 `Total` of $24,785,240; page 142's FY14 column (`13-14`) totals $24,785,280 once its separately printed debt service of $1,213,204 is added. BOTH PAGES FOOT TO THEMSELVES EXACTLY -- page 143's eight subtotals add to its own $24,785,240 to the dollar, and page 142's seven categories add to its own printed $23,572,076 to the dollar. What the two pages disagree about is not one figure but SEVEN OF THE EIGHT CATEGORIES: District Leadership +28,947, Instruction +127,698, Student Services -75,676, Operations & Maintenance +75,769, Fixed Charges -115,029, Fixed Assets -15,000, Tuition -26,749, debt service identical -- and those seven differences NET to exactly -$40. A mistyped digit cannot produce seven offsets between $15,000 and $127,698. So the two pages carry TWO DIFFERENT TABULATIONS of FY2014, not one tabulation printed twice, and the $40 is the residue of that. WHICH TABULATION IS RIGHT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: nothing on either page says, and re-auditing, reclassification between functions and a later restatement all fit the same evidence equally. For FY15 through FY18 the two pages do print one tabulation and they agree. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH. These are a REGIONAL DISTRICT'S figures for its whole district, not Lunenburg's share of them: Lunenburg's assessment is on page 148 and is a different quantity. A function code is a spending CATEGORY and not a programme, a school or a headcount, and the page prints dollars against categories and nothing else -- it says nothing about staff, students or services. The `Percentage Incr/Decr` column is a ratio the page computes from the two columns either side of the actual/budget boundary; it is transcribed as printed and no check here asserts it.
